blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Oct. 31 compliance deadline for the mandatory online posting of the Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) Registration Seal Badge has been suspended until further notice. BIR Commissioner Charlito Martin R. Mendoza announced the suspension in a statement issued on Monday.
